defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

options.content:
**Showing `$provenance` data, task `$task`.** `captured` = arrived on the local OTLP port (not proof of authenticity: any local process can post there). `synthetic` = the repo's hand-written fixtures, used only by `stack.ps1 selftest`.

* **Missing is not zero.** Empty panels say *No data in range*. The Coverage table marks expected signals that never arrived as **not seen**. Nothing here substitutes 0 for missing data.
* **Tokens: one canonical source per harness, never summed across signals or harnesses.** Copilot harnesses: `gen_ai.client.token.usage` (per model call). Claude Code: `claude_code.token.usage`. Agent-level `invoke_agent` span tokens are roll-ups that repeat their children; they appear only in the roll-up check.
* **Harness labels come from `service.name`.** `copilot-chat` = the VS Code Copilot Chat extension. `github-copilot` = the GitHub Copilot runtime, which is both the standalone Copilot CLI and VS Code's embedded agent host; nothing verified tells them apart yet, so it is labelled `github-copilot-runtime`. If one VS Code session shows up under both labels, they describe the same work: do not add them.
* **Budget** is a number you type in the `token_budget` variable. It is not your provider plan or subscription quota, and no cost is computed anywhere.
* Sessions are counted from logs and traces; metrics carry no session IDs by design.

panels.title: Expected metric signals in range
panels.description: One row per documented signal and harness. A number is the count of series seen in the time range; 'not seen' means nothing arrived (the harness may be idle, not configured, or not emit it). Generated from probe/expectations.json names.

 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_tool_call_count.*_total",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.tool.call.count", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_tool_call_duration.*_count",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.tool.call.duration", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_agent_turn_count.*_count",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.agent.turn.count", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_agent_invocation_duration.*_count",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.agent.invocation.duration", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_session_count.*_total",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.session.count", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"copilot_chat_time_to_first_token.*_count",workbench_harness="vscode-copilot-chat",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "copilot_chat.time_to_first_token", "", ""), "harness", "vscode-copilot-chat", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum",workbench_harness="github-copilot-runtime",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "gen_ai.client.token.usage", "", ""), "harness", "github-copilot-runtime", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"gen_ai_.*|copilot_chat_.*",workbench_harness="github-copilot-runtime",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "any gen_ai.* / copilot_chat.* metric", "", ""), "harness", "github-copilot-runtime", "", "")

 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"claude_code_active_time.*_total",workbench_harness="claude-code",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "claude_code.active_time.total", "", ""), "harness", "claude-code", "", "")
 or label_replace(label_replace((count(last_over_time({__name__=~"codex_.*",workbench_harness="codex",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range])) or vector(-1)), "signal", "codex.* metrics (any)", "", ""), "harness", "codex", "", "")

panels.title: Spans in range by harness
panels.description: Tempo spans per harness. VS Code emits spans; Claude Code only with its beta tracing flag; Codex is unverified.

defaults.noValue: No spans in range

panels.title: Log events in range by harness
panels.description: Loki log records (events) per harness.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No log events in range

panels.title: Sessions started (metric)
panels.description: Session-start counters. Counted without session IDs on the metric.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness) (increase({__name__=~"copilot_chat_session_count.*_total|claude_code_session_count.*_total",workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))

defaults.noValue: No session counter in range

panels.title: Distinct sessions seen in log events
panels.description: Distinct session.id values in log events (session IDs live in logs, not metric labels).

targets.expr: count by (workbench_harness) (sum by (workbench_harness, session_id) (count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | session_id!="" [$__range])))

defaults.noValue: No session IDs in log events

panels.title: Model calls in range
panels.description: Model round trips per harness and model. Copilot harnesses: gen_ai.client.operation.duration count. Claude Code: api_request events.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))
sum by (model) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_request" [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Models seen (canonical token series)
panels.description: Models with token use in range, per harness (all token types). Per-harness rows; no cross-harness total.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness, model) (label_replace(increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored), "model", "$1", "gen_ai_request_model", "(.*)")) or sum by (workbench_harness, model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Tokens by task, harness and token type
panels.description: Canonical sources only: VS Code gen_ai.client.token.usage, Claude Code claude_code.token.usage. Exact increase over the range. Token types are not comparable across harnesses (Claude 'input' excludes cache; Copilot's is unverified), so there is no cross-harness total.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_task_id, workbench_harness, token_type) (label_replace(increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored), "token_type", "$1", "gen_ai_token_type", "(.*)")) or sum by (workbench_task_id, workbench_harness, token_type) (label_replace(increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored), "token_type", "$1", "type", "(.*)"))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Copilot tokens over time (gen_ai.client.token.usage)
panels.description: Tokens per interval from gen_ai.client.token.usage, per harness (VS Code extension, GitHub Copilot runtime). Series of different harnesses are never stacked into one total.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_request_model, gen_ai_token_type) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_sum{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__interval] anchored))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Claude Code tokens over time
panels.description: Tokens per interval from claude_code.token.usage; query_source separates main thread from subagents.

targets.expr: sum by (model, type, query_source) (increase(claude_code_token_usage_tokens_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__interval] anchored))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

Copilot tool calls by outcome

panels.title: Tool failure rate
panels.description: Failed / all calls per tool. A tool that ran without failing shows 0% (a measured zero: its calls are in the denominator); a tool that never ran has no bar.

targets.expr: (sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_tool_name) (increase(copilot_chat_tool_call_count_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task",success="false"}[$__range] anchored)) or 0 * sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_tool_name) (increase(copilot_chat_tool_call_count_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))) / sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_tool_name) (increase(copilot_chat_tool_call_count_total{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))

(sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="tool_result" | success="false" [$__range])) or 0 * sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="tool_result" [$__range]))) / sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="tool_result" [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.description: Milliseconds. VS Code p95 is interpolated from histogram buckets; Claude Code values are exact over events.

avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="tool_result" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="tool_result" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (tool_name)

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.description: Seconds per model call. VS Code: gen_ai.client.operation.duration. Claude Code: api_request duration_ms.

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, workbench_harness, gen_ai_request_model) (increase(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored)))
avg_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_request" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (model) / 1000
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_request" | unwrap duration_ms [$__range]) by (model) / 1000

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Model round trips per agent turn / prompt
panels.description: VS Code: mean copilot_chat.agent.turn.count per agent invocation. Claude Code: api_request events per distinct prompt.id (includes subagent requests).

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_agent_name) (increase(copilot_chat_agent_turn_count_sum{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored)) / sum by (workbench_harness, gen_ai_agent_name) (increase(copilot_chat_agent_turn_count_count{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task"}[$__range] anchored))

sum(count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_request" [$__range])) / count(sum by (prompt_id) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_request" [$__range])))

defaults.noValue: No data in range (not zero) - see Coverage

panels.title: Model call errors
panels.description: VS Code: operation duration samples carrying error.type. Claude Code: api_error events.

targets.expr: sum by (workbench_harness, error_type) (increase(gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{workbench_provenance="$provenance",workbench_task_id=~"$task",error_type!=""}[$__range] anchored))
sum by (status_code) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code"} | workbench_provenance="$provenance" | workbench_task_id=~"$task" | event_name="api_error" [$__range]))

defaults.noValue: No model call errors recorded in range

panels.title: Agent invocations (spans)
panels.description: invoke_agent spans with their session and task. Token columns here are roll-ups (a parent includes its subagents); use the canonical panels for totals.

targets.query: {span.gen_ai.operation.name="invoke_agent" && resource.workbench.provenance="$provenance" && resource.workbench.task.id=~"$task"} | select(span.gen_ai.agent.name, span.gen_ai.request.model, span.copilot_chat.turn_count, span.gen_ai.usage.input_tokens, span.gen_ai.usage.output_tokens, resource.session.id, resource.workbench.task.id, resource.workbench.harness, resource.service.name)

defaults.noValue: No agent spans in range

panels.title: Subagents: invoke_agent under a tool call
panels.description: Child invoke_agent spans whose parent is an execute_tool span (the subagent pattern the VS Code docs describe). Open a trace ID to see the tree.

defaults.noValue: No subagent spans in range

panels.title: Roll-up check: input tokens on chat spans
panels.description: Sum over chat spans (one per model call). Should match the canonical VS Code input total.

panels.title: Roll-up check: input tokens summed over every invoke_agent span
panels.description: Do not use as a total. Parents include nested subagent usage, so this double-counts whenever a subagent ran. Shown only to make the difference visible.

panels.title: Local token budget (user-set; not a provider quota)
